title: Code of practice for eddy current testing of non-ferrous seamless pipes and tubes
clause_1_scope: This standard prescribes the methods of eddy current detection of defects in seamless pipes and tubular products of outer diameter from approximately 3.0 to 50.0 mm. This standard is applicable only to nonferrous pipes and tubes including cupronickel of uniform cross-section and composition.
clause_3_terminology: Code of practice for eddy current testing of non
Code of practice for eddy current testing of non-ferrous seamless pipes and tubes

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
